 140│     /// The full session memory injected into a run's brief: the Cortex (who Luke is + this project +
 141│     /// recent journal) folded with ProjectMemory (this repo's planning notes). Used by the one-shot
 142│     /// and TUI paths so cortex is injected in EVERY mode, not only the interactive REPL.
 143│     /// Per-cycle token budget: an even share of what REMAINS across the cycles LEFT, floored so a cycle is
 144│     /// never starved below a unit of real work, and capped at the full remaining (the last cycle can use it
 145│     /// all). Adaptive (uses the live remaining), so budget unspent by cheap early cycles flows forward to
 146│     /// finish the task — instead of a rigid total/maxCycles that dies mid-work and forces a fresh restart.
 147│     static func perCycleBudget(remaining: Int, cycleIndex: Int, maxCycles: Int, floor: Int = 60_000) -> Int {
 148│         guard remaining > 0 else { return 0 }
 149│         let cyclesLeft = max(1, maxCycles - cycleIndex)
 150│         let evenShare = remaining / cyclesLeft
 151│         return min(remaining, max(floor, evenShare))
 152│     }
